NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author split the single commit into three focused commits (drag-and-drop fix, auto-fill, multi-file upload). They also added screenshots and videos for each UI change and tests for the auto-fill behavior.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The description now covers what changed, testing, "Fixes #20316" and screenshots/videos for each feature. |
| ✅  | The commits are now separate and each does one thing, as the PR guide asks. |
| ✅  | The linked issue has "help wanted" and is assigned to the author. |
| ℹ️  | CI status isn't visible to the bot. The author says all checks pass, so confirm before merging. The description also doesn't show the self-review checklist, and the author left the batch-vs-per-file upload approach open for maintainers to decide. |

**Reviewer:** laurynmm — gave the earlier feedback and can weigh in on the open question about the multi-file approach.
